record.title: The zero-forcing consequence of the minimal-forts bound
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a graph, let $n$ be its order, and let $\mathcal{F}_G$ denote the family of minimal forts of $G$. Let $\operatorname{Z}(G)$ denote the zero forcing number of $G$. **Zero-forcing consequence conjecture.** If

$$
\lvert\mathcal{F}_G\rvert = n/3,
$$

then

$$
\operatorname{Z}(G)=n/3.
$$

The paper presents this as an observation supported by examples and by a proposition relating minimal forts, fort number, and zero forcing number; no general proof or resolution is supplied.
record.source_name: Thomas R. Cameron and Kelvin Li, “On the minimal forts of trees”, arXiv:2512.12874 (2026).
record.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12874

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2025).
